title: AI Dev Pipeline - run state
description: Canonical snapshot of a pipeline run, exactly as serialized by aidp (crate::run::RunState). Reconciled with the Rust struct and pinned by a round-trip test (WI-P0-5).

pipeline_path.description: Path to the pipeline YAML that started the run.

run_dir.description: Absolute path of this run's directory: <vault>/Pipelines/<repo>/<feature>/<run_id>/ when a vault is configured (v7 default), else the legacy <workspace>/.aidp/pipelines/<feature>/<run_id>/.

vault_root.description: v7: the Obsidian vault this run's artefacts were written into. Absent/null means the legacy in-repo .aidp/pipelines/ layout. Persisted (not re-resolved) so notes are always regenerated in the vault the run started in.

knowledge_root.description: v7: the per-project knowledge base directory (<vault>/Knowledge/<repo>/, or <workspace>/.aidp/knowledge/ in the legacy layout). Holds the durable service documentation written by knowledge stages and read back as input by later runs.

repo.description: v7: the repo segment of the vault path (Pipelines/<repo>/…), derived from the git origin remote, falling back to the workspace directory name.

feature.description: v7: the feature segment grouping every run for one feature (an explicit `feature` input, else the ticket list, else `_no-ticket`). Names the folder ticket_root() points at.

inputs.description: Resolved pipeline inputs at run start.

plan.description: Topo-sorted layers of stage names (each inner array is one parallel layer).

loops.description: Per-loop-container iteration state, keyed by loop stage name.

workflow_run_id.description: v7: the Workflow-tool runId used for resumeFromRunId. Persisted so resume survives a lost transcript.

pending_gate.description: v7: the gate the run is currently paused at, awaiting a human decision. Persisted with workflow_run_id the moment a gate is proposed (before approval), so a resume can re-propose that exact gate instead of re-running the whole pipeline. Cleared when the gate is approved.

mode.description: Execution mode of the run: driven by the Workflow tool, or natively by the daemon. Absent for a Workflow-driven run.

last_workflow_status.description: v7: the raw status of the last folded-in Workflow result ("done", "paused", "awaiting_gate", …), captured by `run reconcile`. Distinct from the derived overall_status: a run can have every reached stage Success and still be awaiting_gate, so this is what lets a note say the run is paused rather than reading it as finished.

gates.description: v7: gate decisions recorded across resumes. Approvals are baked into the emitted __approved seed.

plan_schedules.description: v7: compiled plan_tasks schedules, keyed by stage name. Written by `aidp workflow emit` on the pass that resolves the planner's plan.json; task outcomes are folded back in by `run reconcile`.

cost.description: v7: run-level cost rollup, attached best-effort at the end of `run reconcile` from the transcript ledger (crate::tokens / crate::cost) rather than the self-reported, self-averaged metrics.tokens_used a parallel task group hands back divided evenly across its members.

knowledge_graph.description: Workspace knowledge-graph snapshot, populated at init when settings.knowledge_graph.enabled = true. Absent/null when disabled or skipped.

base_sha.description: C7 (Lot 3): the workspace's `git rev-parse HEAD` at `init` (crate::gitlog::head). Null when the workspace was not a git repository (or git was unavailable) at init time — every feature this feeds (scope verification, `aidp git outcomes`) treats that as skipped, not failed.

head_sha_end.description: C7: the workspace's HEAD as observed at the end of `run reconcile` (best-effort). Read together with base_sha to know what commit range this run actually produced.

branch.description: C7: the branch `init` found checked out (`git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD`), best-effort.

commits.description: C7: commit shas observed at the end of `run reconcile` (crate::gitlog::log, best-effort, most-recent-first, bounded). An audit trail for `aidp git outcomes` and similar tooling, not a full log.

scope_violations.description: C7: the result of `scope::verify_run` at the end of `run reconcile`, when settings.verify_scope (default true) is enabled. Never changes reconcile's exit code by itself — see `aidp scope verify` for the command that fails loudly on what this collects.

vault_leaks.description: LOC-46: run/doc artefacts that were written into the repo working tree instead of the configured vault — a placement bug, detected by `vault_leak::detect` and populated by `run reconcile` whenever a vault is configured. Deliberately kept separate from `scope_violations`: a `repo_wide` stage accepts a `Pipelines/...` path as in-scope, which is exactly why that check alone could never catch this bug class. Unlike `scope_violations`, this DOES change the exit code — see `aidp scope verify` / `aidp run reconcile`, which exit 2 when this is non-empty.

guard_findings.description: C5 (Lot 3): the __guardFindings array the emitted Workflow script's __guard helper accumulates at every stage-boundary recomposition (fanin/taskin/up/taskUp), folded in by `run reconcile` from result.guard_findings on all four of the script's returns (done/paused/awaiting_gate/awaiting_plan) — a run paused by an injection is exactly the one whose findings matter most. Framing only, never a gate: reconcile never fails or blocks on this.

source.description: Which recomposition call produced this hit, e.g. fanin:review, taskin:T1, up:plan, taskUp:T2.

knowledge_snapshot.description: LOC-44: frozen read of the project knowledge base, captured by `run::ensure_knowledge_snapshot` right before this run's first `aidp workflow emit` compiles the script. Reused by every later re-emit of the same run so a read-only stage's prompt (and therefore its Workflow cache key) does not drift just because an upstream knowledge-writing stage touched the base in between. Null/absent for a run-state written before this field existed, or before the first emit.

entries.description: Transverse note filenames, as `knowledge::entries` lists them.

feature_resolution.description: The rendered create-or-update decision block a feature-layer writer stage (`knowledge: feature|true`) embeds in its prompt, frozen at the same first emit. That stage creates the note it resolves, so a live read on a later re-emit would flip `create` into `update`, change its prompt, and re-run it (and `plan` after it) on resume. Absent when the pipeline has no feature-layer writer, or for a snapshot captured before this field existed.

init_warnings.description: Warnings collected at `run init` time — an undeclared input, an unparseable `when:`/`gate:` expression — surfaced on the run instead of printed. Absent for a run-state written before this field existed.

autonomous.description: True when the run is autonomous: stages never ask a question and journal their choices in `assumptions`.

assumptions.description: Choices autonomous stages took in place of a question.

tokens_used.description: Total tokens consumed by the sub-agent during this stage.

outputs.description: Map of declared output name -> path.

summary.description: v7: the sub-agent's one-paragraph reply summary, folded in by `run reconcile`. Rendered in the generated Obsidian stage note.

follow_ups.description: v7: the sub-agent's follow_ups, folded in by `run reconcile` and rendered as checkboxes in the run note.

skills_not_loaded.description: v7: declared skills the sub-agent did not load, folded in from `signals.skills_not_loaded` by `run reconcile`. Plan-task entries read `<task>: <skill>`. Shown as a warning in the run summary.

usage.description: v7: this stage's usage as attributed from the transcript ledger, attached best-effort at the end of `run reconcile`.

verification.description: C7 (Lot 3): syntactic findings on this stage's declared outputs (crate::verify::verify_outputs) — an unbalanced code fence, a refusal pattern, invalid JSON, and the like. Purely annotation, never a gate.

planSchedule.description: How aidp parallelised one plan-driven stage: the task graph it compiled from plan.json, plus every ordering it had to insert.

plan_path.description: The plan.json this schedule was compiled from.

width.description: Widest wave: the most tasks that could ever run at once.

waves.description: Task ids per dependency level. Reporting only — dispatch is dependency-driven, not wave-gated.

serializations.description: Orderings aidp inserted because two otherwise-concurrent tasks wrote the same file.

warnings.description: Non-fatal contract slips in the plan (a task claiming a shared file, a cross-stage dependency, a task with no owned file).

deps.description: Declared dependencies only: the plan's `needs`, resolved within this stage's claimed tasks. A blocked/failed entry here cancels this task. Does NOT include file-lock orderings aidp inserted on its own — see `mutex_after`.

mutex_after.description: Orderings aidp inserted (C9, Lot 3 Capitalisation) because this task and an earlier one write the same file — never a semantic dependency. Execution still waits for these, but a failed entry here does NOT cancel this task, only warns it. Absent on a run-state written before this field existed.

stageUsage.description: Per-stage usage attributed from the transcript ledger (crate::tokens::scan_run_agents), not the self-reported/self-averaged metrics.tokens_used.

bucket.description: Deterministic complexity bucket (crate::cost::bucket): small | medium | large.

source.description: Provenance of this usage figure: jsonl (measured from the agent transcript), budget (fallback to the sub-agent-reported, output-only tokens_used), or unavailable (the ledger could not be read — never shown as a silent zero).

featureNote.description: One feature note as read from disk (crate::knowledge::FeatureNote), frozen into a knowledge_snapshot.

slug.description: Stable identity, and the file stem. Kebab-case, ASCII.

files.description: Repo-relative paths of the files that carry this feature.

findings.description: guard::scan hits on this note's injectable metadata strings.

guard_off.description: Mirrors the note's `aidp_guard: off` frontmatter escape hatch.

runCost.description: Run-level cost rollup, attached best-effort at the end of `run reconcile`.

by_model.description: StageUsage aggregated per model id across the whole run.
